SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName FROM sys_user u
JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = '0'
u.status = '0'
AND r.role_key = #{roleKey}
AND (u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.user_id ASC

SELECT log.id, log.action, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, '系统') AS operator, CONCAT(log.target_type, '#', log.target_id) AS target, log.create_time AS createTime FROM sys_operation_log log LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = log.user_id ORDER BY log.id DESC
